run.prompt: Draw an animated SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Make the wheels turn and the pelican pedal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
run.notes: First and only generation; the accepted output's bytes were not modified after writing. Geometry and animation were computed by a Python script: wheels, crank and clouds rotate/drift via CSS keyframes; each leg is a two-bone IK solve (L1 95, L2 97, crank radius 30) baked into 20 keyframes per 1.6 s pedal revolution so both webbed feet track the pedal spindles exactly; nested foot groups counter-rotate (F = -(A+B)) to keep feet level; the upper body bobs twice per revolution; prefers-reduced-motion disables all animation; the poster is the same file with the style element removed. Render-checked in headless Chrome (animated frame and poster) before accepting. Context is declared existing-conversation: the protocol documents, schema, validator, manifest and existing metadata records were read in this conversation before authoring; the first ~80 lines of one existing submission's SVG source (glm-5-3) were viewed to confirm structural conventions (transform-box usage, nested leg groups); no other submitted artwork was viewed. Model identity Kimi-K3 is the name the harness/system reports and is not independently verified, so model.id is null. WorkBuddy version 5.8.3 read from the application bundle. Cosmetic defects recorded rather than corrected: the chain is static and does not animate; pedals are drawn as rotation-invariant circles; both legs share one screen plane; the saddle is mostly occluded by the body; the bird reads somewhat goose-like, with a shorter neck and smaller pouch than a real pelican; clouds loop discontinuously at the wrap point.
